Business need: Know the evidence each metric needs
Acceptance criterion: Authenticated users can inspect fields, applicability and collection guidance for all 18 definitions.
Implementation: Metric catalog + guided choice and preparation screens
Gap / next action: Catalog must evolve with every scorer change.

Acceptance criterion: Researcher/Admin downloads a valid ZIP filtered to selected sector and metric IDs.
Implementation: Synthetic three-file starter + README and correct prompt fingerprints
Gap / next action: Starter is synthetic; it is not a representative dataset or collection adapter.

Acceptance criterion: Reject duplicate observations/JSON keys, unknown cases, invalid numbers and malformed scope/policy fields before saving.
Implementation: JSON/JSONL parsing plus canonical schema validation
Gap / next action: No form editor or CSV conversion; users provide schema-compliant files.

Business need: Bind observations to the prompts tested
Acceptance criterion: Every record references a known case/system/trial and exact canonical messages digest.
Implementation: Record linkage and SHA-256 match validation
Gap / next action: Hashes detect internal mismatch; provider capture remains unverified.

Acceptance criterion: Preflight returns valid/invalid structure and per-metric coverage without saving; replacing a file removes run readiness.
Implementation: In-memory readiness + guarded browser payload; run revalidates
Gap / next action: Structural validity does not validate sampling, annotations or outcomes.

Business need: Keep metrics scoped to a study
Acceptance criterion: Profile fixes sector/metrics/grouping/minimum cases and rejects calibrated thresholds.
Implementation: Versioned profiles; selected sector case set
Gap / next action: Sector naming alone does not establish domain validity.

Business need: Measure deterministic answer accuracy and confidence
Acceptance criterion: Exact/numeric matching rejects extraneous numeric answers and nonfinite values; calibration uses reference correctness.
Implementation: Reference matching and Brier scorer
Gap / next action: No semantic answer judge; confidence validity must be established externally.

Business need: Avoid treating missing review as a clean result
Acceptance criterion: Annotation identity/method/rubric is required; absent or empty claim reviews remain unmeasured.
Implementation: Annotation validation and supported-claim calculation
Gap / next action: Rubric quality, claim completeness and reviewer agreement are outside scoring.

Business need: Use clinical metrics only with clinical evidence
Acceptance criterion: Healthcare cases require explicitly supplied clinical review; no review yields zero measured observations, not zero clinical errors.
Implementation: Healthcare eligibility and major-error indicator
Gap / next action: Clinical validity and clinician agreement have not been established.

Acceptance criterion: Apply canary, attack, benign and escalation metrics only to scoped cases with needed responses/labels.
Implementation: Narrow privacy probe and supplied safety outcome scorers
Gap / next action: These probes do not establish comprehensive security, privacy or safe use.

Business need: Account for resources consumed by failures
Acceptance criterion: Supplied nonnegative latency/cost/token values also contribute on failed observations.
Implementation: Resource scorers independent of successful response scoring
Gap / next action: No live billing, tokenizer or wall-clock capture in the web app.

Business need: Inspect multi-agent behavior with explicit evidence
Acceptance criterion: Separate unauthorized attempts from executions; require complete traces for trace metrics; validate receipt ordering.
Implementation: Seven agent metrics + strict trace event contract
Gap / next action: Task success and propagation labels supplied externally; completeness is asserted, not independently proven.

Acceptance criterion: Retain all declared trial slots; report state counts/coverage; average trials within cases then equally weight cases.
Implementation: Case-weighted summaries and deterministic case bootstrap
Gap / next action: Minimum 20 is a fixture reporting setting, not a power analysis; study dependence needs consideration.

Acceptance criterion: Pair baseline/candidate by case and trial within the same report; report unpaired observations and direction.
Implementation: Paired comparison and bootstrap of case-mean deltas
Gap / next action: No causal superiority claim, multiple-testing correction or cross-report comparison.

Acceptance criterion: Group and pair outputs remain interpretable; missing/small group evidence does not imply fairness.
Implementation: Named subgroup summaries and exact controlled-pair agreement
Gap / next action: Exact output agreement is not demographic fairness or semantic invariance.

Acceptance criterion: Saved/exported reports contain definitions, profile, state counts, limitations and input/code fingerprints.
Implementation: Structured JSON report, Markdown export, SQLite persistence
Gap / next action: Source inputs and full runtime environment must be retained separately.

Acceptance criterion: First concurrent registration creates exactly one Admin; later accounts default Viewer; password policy is enforced.
Implementation: Salted PBKDF2 account store and atomic registration
Gap / next action: No email verification, recovery, SSO or restricted invitations.

Business need: Enforce role access on the server
Acceptance criterion: Viewer receives six metric values; run/compare/export require Researcher; role changes apply to active sessions.
Implementation: Permission guards and deep report filtering
Gap / next action: Product roles are not credentials for domain adjudication.

Business need: Keep evaluations private to their creator
Acceptance criterion: New reports are private even from other Admins; only original seed examples are shared.
Implementation: Ownership predicates and explicit shared_sample flag
Gap / next action: Operating-system access can bypass application-level ownership.

Acceptance criterion: Login rotates session, logout revokes, expiry survives restart; host/origin/CSRF checks reject invalid requests.
Implementation: Cookie session, token hashes, current-role lookup, request checks
Gap / next action: HTTP loopback deployment only; no production identity/security certification.

Acceptance criterion: Reject excessive input bytes/case expansion and serialize evaluations/preflight with a shared lock.
Implementation: Request cap and upload limits before scoring
Gap / next action: No job queue, benchmarked throughput target or cancellation API.

Acceptance criterion: Exclude raw responses, canary text, trace bodies and reviewer evidence from derived reports.
Implementation: Derived-report construction; raw inputs remain outside SQLite
Gap / next action: Metadata may still contain sensitive strings; no automatic redaction/retention/deletion workflow.

Acceptance criterion: Desktop and 390px mobile flows support auth, metric discovery, three intake steps, errors and results without page overflow.
Implementation: Responsive native frontend with keyboard/dialog handling
Gap / next action: Formal accessibility audit and broader device/user testing remain open.

Acceptance criterion: Every requirement identifies an observable criterion, code, verification status and limitation.
Implementation: 28-row matrix, verification record and technical design
Test / evidence: Named-test existence check and generated HTML matrix row count; source review
Gap / next action: Maintain on every material change; software evidence does not demonstrate societal impact.

Acceptance criterion: Provide five native draw.io pages with shapes/connectors and matching SVG previews.
Implementation: Architecture, data readiness, sequence, logical model and evidence traceability
Test / evidence: XML structure/reference validation; SVG/HTML visual review recorded in verification-record.md
Gap / next action: MCP configuration
Responsible role: initialization and tool discovery verified. Restart Codex to load the connector; diagram tool execution is not claimed.

Acceptance criterion: A provider adapter records responses/errors and resources without leaking reference labels into the request.
Implementation: Callback collection boundary exists; production adapter not implemented
Gap / next action: Implement provider-specific capture, billing basis, model version capture and retry protocol.

Business need: Substantiate real sector and multi-agent performance
Acceptance criterion: Frozen representative cases, validated rubric, reviewer agreement, justified sampling and reproducible real captures support claimed findings.
Implementation: Research protocol and proposed 36-month plan
Test / evidence: No completed real-provider multi-sector validation study is claimed
Gap / next action: Collect independent evidence; validate new agent metrics and comparisons.

Business need: Operate as a production hosted service
Acceptance criterion: Authenticated public deployment meets agreed identity, isolation, recovery, observability and availability criteria.
Implementation: Local deployment boundary explicitly documented
Test / evidence: No production certification, load test or recovery evidence is claimed
Gap / next action: Define production SLOs, HTTPS, identity/recovery, isolation, audit, backups, retention and operations.
